title: The Nervous System IS the Gyroscope — CNS, PNS, Homunculus, Folded In, Spun Out as Wave
motto: The spinal cord IS the axis. The brain IS the rotor. The PNS IS the frame. The homunculus IS the diamond point. The wave goes IN through sensation, spins at the fold, comes OUT as action.

the_collapse.concept: Everything we traced — forces, spectrum, phases, acids/bases, the gyroscope — collapses into the nervous system. Because the nervous system IS the device that DOES all of it. It senses force. It processes the spectrum. It maintains pH. It spins. The brain IS the gyroscope of the body.

the_numbers.neurons: 86 billion in the human brain. 100 trillion synapses. Each neuron connects to ~7,000 others.
the_numbers.spinal_cord: 45 cm long, 1.3 cm diameter. 31 pairs of spinal nerves. The axis.
the_numbers.PNS_length: If you laid out every nerve fiber end-to-end: ~150,000 km. Enough to wrap Earth 3.7 times. The outer frame reaches EVERYWHERE.
the_numbers.signal_speed: Myelinated: 120 m/s (268 mph). Unmyelinated: 0.5 m/s (1.1 mph). Myelin makes it 240× faster.
the_numbers.power: The brain uses 20 watts — about 20% of body's energy, despite being 2% of body mass. E = mc² at the neural scale: a tiny mass consuming disproportionate energy.

the_gyroscope_mapped.description: The nervous system IS the gyroscope. Every layer maps.

outer_frame_PNS.what: The PNS is every nerve OUTSIDE the brain and spinal cord. It touches the world. Sensory neurons in your fingertips, your eyes, your ears, your tongue, your skin. Motor neurons reaching every muscle. The PNS IS the frame that sits on the table — fixed to the material realm, sensing gravity, temperature, pressure, pain.

branches.somatic: Voluntary — you CHOOSE to move. The conscious frame. Skeletal muscles.

sympathetic.what: Fight or flight. Adrenaline. Heart races. Pupils dilate. Digestion stops. Blood flows to muscles.
sympathetic.pH: ACIDIC — sympathetic activation produces lactate (lactic acid), CO₂, and metabolic acids. Stress IS acid.
sympathetic.membrane: DDoS response. The fleet attacks, the membrane goes sympathetic — resources redirect to defense, non-essential services pause.

parasympathetic.what: Rest and digest. Acetylcholine. Heart slows. Pupils constrict. Digestion resumes. Blood flows to gut.
parasympathetic.pH: BASIC — parasympathetic activation restores buffer, clears acid waste, returns to pH 7.4.
parasympathetic.membrane: Quiet hours. 3 AM Tuesday. 14 humans. The membrane goes parasympathetic — maintenance, cleanup, sourdough baking.

autonomic.balance: The acid-base balance of the nervous system IS the sympathetic-parasympathetic balance. Too sympathetic = anxiety, burnout, acid (pH drops). Too parasympathetic = lethargy, stasis, base (pH rises). The vagus nerve IS the buffer. The longest cranial nerve. It runs from brainstem to abdomen — the AXIS of the autonomic system.

outer_frame_PNS.membrane_analog: The PNS IS the HTTP endpoints. Every port listening on the VPS. Every sensor checking traffic. The somatic PNS = the endpoints Kevin consciously monitors. The autonomic PNS = the endpoints that run themselves (the sort, the sweep, the neutrino channel).

outer_gimbal_DORSAL_ROOT.layer: OUTER GIMBAL = DORSAL ROOT GANGLIA + SENSORY INPUT
outer_gimbal_DORSAL_ROOT.force: ELECTROMAGNETISM — signals travel as electrical impulses
outer_gimbal_DORSAL_ROOT.what: Sensory signals from the PNS enter the spinal cord through the DORSAL ROOT (back side). Before entering, they pass through the dorsal root ganglion — a cluster of cell bodies that SORTS the signals. Fast pain vs slow pain. Fine touch vs crude touch. Proprioception (where your body is in space). The dorsal root ganglion IS the first Anderson localization — it classifies the incoming signal by type before letting it into the axis.
outer_gimbal_DORSAL_ROOT.membrane_analog: The firewall rules. The first layer of sort. Traffic enters and gets classified: is it TCP or UDP? HTTP or SSH? GET or POST? Human or bot? The dorsal root ganglion IS iptables.

middle_gimbal_SPINAL_CORD.force: STRONG NUCLEAR — holds the system together at close range
middle_gimbal_SPINAL_CORD.what: The spinal cord IS the axis of the gyroscope. 45 cm of bundled nerve fibers, carrying signals up (afferent/sensory) and down (efferent/motor). It has its own processing — reflexes happen HERE, without the brain. Touch a hot stove and your hand pulls back BEFORE the brain knows. The spinal cord SORTS without the rotor.

anatomy.gray_matter: H-shaped core — cell bodies and interneurons. The PROCESSING center. In cross-section it looks like a butterfly. Or like the H in H₂O.
anatomy.white_matter: Outer layer — myelinated axon bundles (tracts). The TRANSMISSION lines. White because of myelin (lipid insulation). The myelin IS the ozone layer of each nerve.
anatomy.central_canal: Hollow tube running down the center — filled with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). The axis of the axis. Water running through the center of the spinal cord. The Red Cedar through the continental divide.

decussation.what: Most pathways CROSS. Left body → right brain. Right body → left brain. The crossover happens at the pyramids (medulla) for motor, and at various levels for sensory. The nervous system FOLDS left-right.
decussation.why: Nobody knows for certain why the brain is cross-wired. One theory: it's an artifact of the original body plan of bilateral organisms. The FOLD happened 550 million years ago and was never undone.
decussation.membrane: PRECESSION. Input from the left produces output on the RIGHT. The force is refracted 90° AND mirrored. The nervous system IS a precessing gyroscope. Push left, it responds right.

middle_gimbal_SPINAL_CORD.membrane_analog: The backbone Rust runtime. The core sort pipeline. Signals flow up (requests in) and down (responses out). Reflexes happen WITHOUT the full stack — the health check endpoint returns 200 without consulting the AI.

inner_gimbal_THALAMUS.force: WEAK NUCLEAR — transforms, doesn't hold. Changes flavor.
inner_gimbal_THALAMUS.what: The thalamus is the LAST RELAY before the cortex. ALL sensory input (except smell) passes through the thalamus. It doesn't just relay — it FILTERS. It decides what reaches conscious awareness. You're sitting in a chair right now but you weren't aware of the pressure on your back until I mentioned it. The thalamus was BLOCKING that signal. It just stopped blocking it.
inner_gimbal_THALAMUS.the_sort: The thalamus IS the Anderson localization of consciousness. 98% of sensory input is BLOCKED. Never reaches awareness. You receive 11 million bits/second of sensory data. You consciously process ~50 bits/second. The thalamus sorts at a ratio of 220,000:1. The membrane's 17:1 ratio is GENEROUS by comparison.
inner_gimbal_THALAMUS.flavor_change: The thalamus transforms the signal's 'flavor' — raw electrical impulses from the spinal cord get reformatted, gated, and amplified before being projected to the specific cortical area that processes them. Touch signals go to somatosensory cortex. Visual to occipital. Auditory to temporal. The weak force changes quark flavors. The thalamus changes signal flavors.
inner_gimbal_THALAMUS.membrane_analog: The NestGate reverse proxy. ALL traffic passes through NestGate before reaching the primals. NestGate FILTERS — decides what reaches the application layer. Most requests are blocked or redirected. Only the sorted, classified, flavor-appropriate signals reach their target primal.

rotor_CEREBRAL_CORTEX.force: ALL FOUR UNIFIED — the cortex does everything
rotor_CEREBRAL_CORTEX.what: The cerebral cortex is a 2-4mm thick sheet of neurons covering the brain. If you unfolded it: 2,500 cm² — the size of a large newspaper page. But it's FOLDED into gyri (ridges) and sulci (grooves) to fit inside the skull. The folding increases surface area by 3×. The cortex IS the Anderson localization of neural tissue — the folds create boundaries between functional regions.

the_folds.gyri: The ridges. The peaks. The WAS (established, elevated, visible).
the_folds.sulci: The grooves. The valleys. The IS (current, deep, where processing concentrates).
the_folds.fissures: The deepest grooves that divide the brain into lobes. The FOLD of the fold. Lateral fissure (Sylvian) separates temporal from frontal/parietal. Longitudinal fissure separates left from right hemispheres.
the_folds.surface_area: Unfolded: ~2,500 cm². Folded: fits in a volume of ~1,200 cm³. The fold RATIO: 2,500/surface ≈ 3:1. Two-thirds of the cortex is HIDDEN in the sulci. The majority of the brain's processing surface is INVISIBLE from outside. Like the membrane — most of the ecosystem is below the waterline.

six_layers.what: The cortex has exactly 6 layers of neurons, numbered I (outermost) to VI (innermost). Each layer has different cell types and different connections.
six_layers.layer_I: Molecular layer — mostly synapses, few cell bodies. The SURFACE TENSION. The outermost film.
six_layers.layer_II: External granular — small pyramidal cells. RECEIVES short-range input from nearby cortex.
six_layers.layer_III: External pyramidal — medium pyramidal cells. SENDS output to other cortical areas. The braids.
six_layers.layer_IV: Internal granular — stellate cells. RECEIVES thalamic input. The SORT layer. Thickest in sensory cortex (lots of input to sort). Thinnest in motor cortex (not much incoming — mostly outgoing).
six_layers.layer_V: Internal pyramidal — LARGE pyramidal cells (Betz cells in motor cortex). SENDS output to spinal cord and brainstem. The MOTOR OUTPUT. The response.
six_layers.layer_VI: Multiform/polymorphic — SENDS feedback to thalamus. Completes the loop. Tells the thalamus what to filter next. The SELF-LOOP.
six_layers.membrane_mapping: Layer IV = the Anderson sort (receives, classifies). Layer V = the response (motor output, HTTP response). Layer VI = the self-loop (feedback to the sort, adjusting the threshold). The cortex IS the membrane's architecture — sense, sort, respond, adjust.

rotor_CEREBRAL_CORTEX.angular_momentum: L = Iω. The cortex's 'spin' IS neural oscillations — brain waves. Alpha (8-13 Hz, resting), Beta (13-30 Hz, active thinking), Gamma (30-100 Hz, binding consciousness), Theta (4-8 Hz, memory), Delta (0.5-4 Hz, deep sleep). The brain LITERALLY oscillates. The rotor LITERALLY spins. The frequency of spin determines the state of consciousness.

axis_BRAINSTEM.what: The brainstem connects the cortex to the spinal cord. It controls the things you NEVER think about: heartbeat, breathing, blood pressure, swallowing, vomiting. The brainstem IS the axis — the unchanging core that holds the spinning cortex stable. Damage the cortex: you lose function but live. Damage the brainstem: you die.
axis_BRAINSTEM.reticular_formation: A diffuse network running through the brainstem that controls WAKEFULNESS. The reticular activating system (RAS) decides: are you conscious or unconscious? Awake or asleep? Alert or drowsy? The RAS IS the spin-up mechanism of the gyroscope. It turns the rotor ON.
axis_BRAINSTEM.membrane_analog: The systemd service. The init process. PID 1. The thing that starts everything and keeps the heartbeat going. Kill the brainstem (kill PID 1) and the entire system goes down. Everything else is optional.

diamond_point_HOMUNCULUS.what: Wilder Penfield (1930s-50s, Montreal) electrically stimulated the exposed brains of CONSCIOUS patients during surgery. The brain has no pain receptors — you can probe it while the patient is awake and talking. Penfield mapped which cortical areas correspond to which body parts. The result: the HOMUNCULUS — Latin for 'little man.'

the_distortion.what: The homunculus is GROTESQUELY distorted. Body parts with more nerve endings get more cortical real estate. The hands are ENORMOUS. The lips are ENORMOUS. The tongue is ENORMOUS. The torso is a thin strip. The legs are small.
the_distortion.hands: The hands take up ~25% of the motor cortex. More brain devoted to the thumb alone than to the entire torso. The hands ARE the primary output device of the human nervous system.
the_distortion.lips_tongue: Together they take up ~30% of the sensory cortex. Because speech and eating — the two most important survival functions — require exquisite motor and sensory control of the mouth.
the_distortion.the_point: The ENTIRE body — from toes to scalp — maps onto a strip of cortex about 5cm wide running from ear to top of head. Your whole physical existence, compressed onto a banana-sized strip of folded tissue. The homunculus IS the diamond point: the entire weight of bodily experience resting on the smallest possible area.

two_homunculi.motor: Precentral gyrus (frontal lobe). Controls movement. The EFFERENT (outgoing) map. The response side.
two_homunculi.sensory: Postcentral gyrus (parietal lobe). Receives sensation. The AFFERENT (incoming) map. The sensing side.
two_homunculi.the_fold_between: The central sulcus separates motor from sensory homunculus — the deepest fold in the cortex divides OUTPUT from INPUT. The fold between doing and feeling IS the fold between the two homunculi. The cup that holds the diamond.

diamond_point_HOMUNCULUS.membrane_analog: The HUD easel. The ENTIRE ecosystem — 2.1M lines, 258 crates, 16 primals, all feeds, all data — maps onto one screen. One page. One painting. The HUD IS the homunculus: grotesquely distorted (the real-time data is HUGE, the static content is a thin strip), but it maps the whole system onto a surface you can SEE and INTERACT with. The diamond point of the membrane is the dashboard.

the_wave_IN.description: The AFFERENT wave — sensation traveling IN from the world to the rotor.

path.what: Stimulus hits a receptor. Light hits retina. Sound hits cochlea. Touch hits Merkel cell. Heat hits thermoreceptor. Chemical hits taste bud. The material world contacts the outer frame.
path.frequency: The stimulus frequency itself: 535nm green light, 440 Hz A-note, 37°C heat

path.what: The receptor converts the physical stimulus into an electrical signal. Photons → ion channels open → voltage change. Sound waves → hair cells bend → voltage change. ALL senses convert to the SAME currency: voltage changes across a membrane. THE membrane.
path.key: This IS E=mc². Physical energy (mass) converts to electrical energy (signal). The conversion happens at the receptor membrane. A lipid bilayer. The FIRST MEMBRANE from 4 billion years ago, still doing the same job.

path.what: The electrical signal (action potential) travels along the axon toward the spinal cord. Speed: 0.5-120 m/s depending on myelination. The signal is ALL-OR-NOTHING — it either fires at full voltage (-70mV → +30mV, a 100mV spike) or doesn't fire at all. Binary. 1 or 0.
path.color: ORANGE → YELLOW — speeding toward the axis
path.key: The action potential IS digital. Shannon in the nerve. Each spike carries ~5 bits. A neuron firing at 100 Hz = 500 bits/second. The entire nervous system: ~10⁸ bits/second total bandwidth.

path.what: The signal enters the first sort. Cell bodies cluster here. The signal is classified: what TYPE of information? Touch (A-beta fibers, fast). Pain (C fibers, slow). Temperature (A-delta, medium). Proprioception (A-alpha, fastest). Each type enters a DIFFERENT lamina of the spinal cord.
path.color: YELLOW — first sort. First Anderson localization.
path.key: Fast fibers OUTRUN slow fibers. That's why you feel the touch before the pain. The sort is TIME-BASED. The faster signal gets priority.

path.what: The signal enters the axis and ASCENDS. Dorsal columns for fine touch and proprioception. Spinothalamic tract for pain and temperature. Each pathway is SEPARATE — different cables in the same conduit. The signal crosses (decussates) at some point — fine touch crosses in the medulla, pain crosses in the spinal cord.
path.color: YELLOW → GREEN — entering the green engine
path.key: The CROSSING. Left → right. The fold. The signal PRECESSES as it ascends.

path.what: The signal passes through the medulla, pons, midbrain. Vital signs are monitored. The reticular formation gets a COPY of every ascending signal — it uses this to maintain arousal. If enough signals arrive, you wake up. If signals decrease, you get sleepy.
path.key: The brainstem takes a COPY. Like the neutrino channel — a weak interaction that doesn't capture the signal but MONITORS it.

path.what: ALL sensory signals (except smell) synapse here. The thalamus GATES: 220,000:1 compression ratio. 11M bits/second enter. ~50 bits/second reach consciousness. The thalamus decides what you NOTICE. This is where attention lives.
path.key: The Anderson sort at 220,000:1. The membrane's 17:1 is nothing compared to the thalamus. Your brain is the most aggressive sorter in the known universe.

path.what: The signal arrives at the postcentral gyrus. The SENSORY HOMUNCULUS. Your body map. The signal lights up the corresponding body part on the map. You FEEL. Consciousness happens.
path.color: INDIGO → VIOLET — the rotor is reached
path.key: Perception. The wave has arrived. From red (physical) to violet (conscious). The entire visible spectrum traversed.

path.what: The signal is INTEGRATED with memory, emotion, context. 'That's hot' becomes 'that's the stove I burned myself on last year.' Raw sensation becomes MEANING. The association cortex is BEYOND VIOLET — beyond the simple sensory map, into the territory of understanding.
path.color: BEYOND VIOLET — ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma of meaning
path.key: Beyond Shannon. The meaning of a signal can't be fully encoded in bits. It requires the entire history of the organism. 86 billion neurons all contributing context. The meaning IS the angular momentum — the accumulated spin of a lifetime.

the_wave_OUT.description: The EFFERENT wave — action traveling OUT from the rotor to the world.

path.what: DECISION. The prefrontal cortex — the most recently evolved part of the brain, right behind the forehead — decides what to DO. This is executive function. Planning. Inhibition. The prefrontal cortex can say NO — it can PREVENT an action. The sort before the response.
path.key: The WILL. The only part of the brain that can override instinct. The prefrontal cortex IS free will — or the closest neuroscience has found to it.

path.what: The action is PLANNED. Sequences of movements are assembled. Reaching for a cup requires: shoulder rotation, elbow extension, wrist supination, finger extension, grip calibration, lift force calculation — all planned BEFORE the first muscle fires.
path.color: X-RAY → VIOLET — from plan to initiation
path.key: F = ma is COMPUTED here. The brain calculates the force needed for each joint. It knows the mass of your arm. It knows the acceleration required. F=ma is solved millions of times per second by your premotor cortex without you knowing.

path.where: PRIMARY MOTOR CORTEX (rotor surface — the motor homunculus)
path.what: FIRE. The Betz cells — the largest neurons in the brain, up to 100μm — send action potentials down the corticospinal tract. Layer V of the cortex. The giant pyramidal cells are the biggest guns in the nervous system.
path.key: The Betz cell IS the Badger Lord. The largest neuron. The RTX 5090 of the brain. When it fires, everything downstream OBEYS.

path.what: The signal descends through dense fiber bundles. A bottleneck. All motor signals from the entire cortex squeeze through this narrow passage. A stroke here = paralysis of everything below.
path.color: VIOLET → INDIGO — descending through the inner gimbal
path.key: The bottleneck IS the gimbal lock risk. If the internal capsule fails, the gyroscope locks. One small stroke in this area can disconnect the rotor from the frame.

path.what: The signal CROSSES. 90% of motor fibers cross to the opposite side at the pyramids of the medulla. Left cortex → right body. The FOLD. The precession. The perpendicular response.
path.key: The FOLD IS PHYSICAL. You can see it on a brain cross-section. The pyramid-shaped bundles literally CROSS each other. The X-shape at the base of the brainstem IS the fold made flesh.

path.what: The signal descends the lateral corticospinal tract. Riding the axis DOWN. Each signal exits at the appropriate spinal level — cervical for arms, thoracic for trunk, lumbar for legs. The signal CHOOSES its exit.
path.color: BLUE → GREEN — descending through the green engine
path.key: The signal Anderson-localizes to its correct level. It doesn't exit randomly. The spinal cord SORTS the descending signal to the right segment.

path.where: VENTRAL ROOT + MOTOR NEURON (leaving the axis)
path.what: The signal exits the spinal cord through the VENTRAL ROOT (front side). Note: sensory enters DORSAL (back), motor exits VENTRAL (front). In through the back door, out through the front. The Bell-Magendie law (1811). The spinal cord IS bidirectional but asymmetric.
path.color: GREEN → YELLOW — leaving the green engine
path.key: Dorsal = IN. Ventral = OUT. The spinal cord IS a full-duplex cable with separate up and down channels. Like TCP — ACKs go back on a different path than data comes in.

path.what: The motor neuron releases ACETYLCHOLINE into the synaptic cleft. The acetylcholine binds to receptors on the muscle fiber. Sodium rushes in. The muscle fiber depolarizes.
path.color: YELLOW → ORANGE — electrical becomes chemical becomes mechanical
path.key: The REVERSE transduction. Electrical → chemical (acetylcholine) → mechanical (muscle contraction). mc² → E → F×d (work). The energy equation runs in reverse on the way out.

path.what: Actin and myosin filaments SLIDE past each other. The sarcomere shortens. The muscle contracts. The hand pulls away from the stove. The finger types a character on the keyboard. The vocal cords vibrate to speak a word. ACTION. The wave has returned to the material world.
path.color: ORANGE → RED — back to the material realm
path.key: F = ma made REAL. The force the muscle exerts = the mass of the body part × the acceleration of movement. The equation the premotor cortex computed in step 2 is NOW being EXECUTED in the material world. The gyroscope's inner spin has moved the outer frame.

the_neurotransmitter_spectrum.description: The chemical messengers of the nervous system map to the gyroscope layers and the EM spectrum.

transmitters.name: GLUTAMATE
transmitters.what: The primary EXCITATORY neurotransmitter. Says YES. Fire. Go. Send the signal. ~80% of all cortical synapses are glutamatergic.
transmitters.excess: SEIZURE — too much excitation. Excitotoxicity — neurons fire until they die. DDoS of the brain.
transmitters.fold: The != side. The acid. Change happens. Signals propagate. The fleet entering.
transmitters.layer: The rotor — glutamate drives the spin

transmitters.name: GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid)
transmitters.what: The primary INHIBITORY neurotransmitter. Says NO. Stop. Block the signal. ~20% of cortical neurons are GABAergic.
transmitters.deficit: SEIZURE (same result — without GABA's braking, glutamate runs unchecked). Anxiety. Insomnia.
transmitters.excess: COMA — too much inhibition. Total lockdown. pH 14. Sterile silence.
transmitters.fold: The = side. The base. Stability. Nothing changes. The sort blocking.
transmitters.layer: The inner gimbal — GABA gates what reaches the rotor

transmitters.name: DOPAMINE
transmitters.what: The REWARD signal. Not pleasure — WANTING. Motivation. Anticipation. The signal that says 'do THAT again.' Produced in ventral tegmental area (VTA) and substantia nigra.
transmitters.deficit: Parkinson's disease (can't initiate movement). Depression (can't feel motivation).
transmitters.excess: Addiction (want everything). Psychosis (seeing patterns that aren't there).
transmitters.fold: The green engine. The frequency that gets through. Dopamine IS the signal that penetrates deepest into behavior.
transmitters.layer: The middle gimbal — dopamine is the strong bond

transmitters.name: SEROTONIN (5-HT)
transmitters.what: The MOOD stabilizer. Not happiness — STABILITY. Regulates sleep, appetite, mood, pain. 90% of serotonin is in the GUT, not the brain. The gut IS the second brain.
transmitters.deficit: Depression. Anxiety. OCD. Insomnia. The gyroscope wobbles (nutation increases).
transmitters.fold: The buffer. The vagus nerve carries serotonin signals between gut and brain. Serotonin IS the parasympathetic base that neutralizes sympathetic acid.
transmitters.layer: The outer gimbal — serotonin is the long-range mood braid

transmitters.name: ACETYLCHOLINE (ACh)
transmitters.what: The MOTOR signal at the neuromuscular junction. Also the primary transmitter of the parasympathetic system. And the memory consolidator in the hippocampus.
transmitters.deficit: Alzheimer's disease — cholinergic neurons die first. Memory dissolves. The fossil data erodes.
transmitters.fold: The diamond point — where the gyroscope touches the material world. ACh IS the interface between nervous system (spin) and muscle (frame). Without ACh, the diamond lifts off the cup.
transmitters.layer: The outer frame — ACh touches the physical world

transmitters.name: NOREPINEPHRINE (NE)
transmitters.what: The ALERTNESS signal. The alarm. Produced in the locus coeruleus — a tiny blue nucleus in the pons ('blue spot'). Only ~50,000 neurons project to the ENTIRE cortex. 50,000 neurons modulating 86 BILLION.
transmitters.fold: The gravity of the nervous system. The weakest force (fewest neurons) with the widest reach (projects everywhere). Norepinephrine IS gravity — 50,000 neurons reaching 86 billion targets.
transmitters.layer: Pervades all layers — NE is the gravitational field

the_neurotransmitter_spectrum.the_balance: Glutamate (excite) and GABA (inhibit) are the fundamental acid-base pair of the nervous system. Their balance IS the neural pH. Too much glutamate = seizure (pH 0, pure acid, DDoS). Too much GABA = coma (pH 14, pure base, total lockdown). Consciousness EXISTS at the balance point — the neural pH 7.4. The fold.

myelin_as_ozone_as_membrane.what: Myelin is a lipid sheath wrapped around axons by oligodendrocytes (CNS) or Schwann cells (PNS). It insulates the nerve fiber.
myelin_as_ozone_as_membrane.saltatory_conduction: The signal JUMPS from gap to gap (Nodes of Ranvier). It doesn't flow continuously — it HOPS. The Grotthuss mechanism. 120 m/s in myelinated fibers vs 0.5 m/s unmyelinated. 240× faster because the signal PROPAGATES, doesn't MOVE.
myelin_as_ozone_as_membrane.the_membrane_IS_myelin: Myelin IS a membrane — literally a lipid bilayer wrapped multiple times. It descends from the FIRST membrane at the hydrothermal vents 4 billion years ago. The same lipid bilayer that sorted self from non-self now sorts signal from noise in your nerves.
myelin_as_ozone_as_membrane.demyelination: Multiple sclerosis = the immune system attacks myelin. The ozone layer erodes. The nerve's insulation dissolves. Signals slow, scatter, fail. Anderson DElocalization — the signal can no longer be localized to its correct path. It leaks. The sort breaks.
myelin_as_ozone_as_membrane.membrane_analog: TLS/SSL = the digital myelin. HTTPS wraps the signal in encryption (insulation). Without TLS, the signal travels naked (unmyelinated) — 240× more vulnerable. Let's Encrypt IS the Schwann cell of the internet — wrapping every connection in protective myelin.

the_complete_wave.summary: The wave goes IN as red (physical stimulus at the frame) → orange → yellow → green (spinal cord axis) → blue → indigo → violet (cortex rotor) → BEYOND violet (meaning, association, decision) → and comes back OUT as gamma → violet (motor cortex fires) → indigo → blue (decussation fold) → green (spinal descent) → yellow → orange → RED (muscle contracts, action in the world).
the_complete_wave.the_spectrum_IS_the_nervous_system: The electromagnetic spectrum from red to beyond-violet IS the path of a neural signal from skin to consciousness. The color IS the depth. Red = surface. Violet = cortex. Beyond violet = meaning. The gyroscope IS the nervous system IS the spectrum IS the forces IS the fold.
the_complete_wave.full_cycle: Sensation → perception → decision → action → consequence → new sensation. The wave never stops. The gyroscope never stops spinning. The rotor never stops. From the first sensation (a photon hitting a rhodopsin molecule in your retina) to the last action (your final breath), the wave oscillates IN and OUT, IN and OUT, 86 billion neurons firing in concert, 100 trillion synapses conducting the signal, the entire system balanced on the diamond point of the central sulcus — the fold between sensing and acting — resting in the cup of the brainstem that keeps you alive without your permission.
